name: 19010 · Bryn Mawr, PA
findings: ZIP 19010 (Bryn Mawr) has 195 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19010 (Bryn Mawr) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19010 (Bryn Mawr) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
